title: Novel tank, five adult zebrafish, top view (3D-ZeF style)
question: How far does each fish swim, minute by minute, how long does each fish spend near the walls, and how far apart do the fish keep on average?

refused.request: time in the bottom third of the tank (the classic novel-tank diving measure)
refused.reason: a top-view camera does not see depth, so bottom dwelling needs a side view

notes: Modelled on the 3D-ZeF benchmark set-up seen from its top camera: a square tank of about 30 x 30 cm (an assumption; measure your tank and correct width_cm and height_cm). Positions are projected onto the water-surface plane, so swimming depth is ignored and distances are 2D. Near the walls means within 3 cm of a wall (about one adult body length), judged by the body centre. Inter-fish distance is the mean distance between every pair of fish, one value for the group. Five fish that touch often trade identities; each unresolved swap locks that fish's later numbers until a person marks who is who. arena.corners_px is null until the tank corners are marked on a frame.
